message: Adding foreign key "FK_owner" on "projects" checks every row while blocking writes to "projects" and "users".
why: Adding a foreign key validates every existing row while holding a SHARE ROW EXCLUSIVE lock on both tables, which blocks INSERT, UPDATE, and DELETE until the check finishes.
safeAlternative: Add the constraint with NOT VALID, then run ALTER TABLE ... VALIDATE CONSTRAINT in its own transaction, after the NOT VALID one has committed. VALIDATE holds only a SHARE UPDATE EXCLUSIVE lock, which does not block writes. With TypeORM, migrationsTransactionMode "all" (the default) runs every pending migration in one transaction, so deploy the VALIDATE migration in a later release, or use "each". TypeORM builder calls cannot add NOT VALID, so use queryRunner.query().
